purpose: Cross-language agreement on the release-shipped authority key registry: which documents a runtime accepts, which public-key encodings it refuses, and which key a (purpose, key_id) selects. A refused registry names the one rule it breaks; the rule names are this corpus's, and a refused registry stops evidence verification whichever rule refused it.
warning: Published test keys. A release must never trust them, and their seeds must never sign anything real.
key_id: sha256: and the lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of the 32 raw public-key bytes
seed_derivation: seed_hex is the SHA-256 of the UTF-8 label 'ori-specs evidence-exchange/v2 authority key registry test key <n>'; public_key_hex is its RFC 8032 Ed25519 public key

registries.name: receipt_and_epoch
registries.why: One active key for each of the two purposes a release carries today.

registries.name: receipt_only
registries.why: A registry need not hold every purpose; the one it holds has one active key.

registries.name: all_three_purposes
registries.why: The disposition purpose is in the vocabulary.

registries.name: rotation
registries.why: An active key, its verify_only predecessor and a revoked one under one purpose.

registries.name: sign_bit_set
registries.why: A canonical key whose byte 31 has bit 7 set is not refused: bit 255 is the sign of x.

registries.name: extra_document_member
registries.why: The document carries exactly schema and keys.

registries.name: extra_key_member
registries.why: Each key carries exactly its four members.

registries.name: public_key_uppercase
registries.why: public_key_hex is lowercase; the key_id derives from the same bytes.

registries.name: key_id_not_derived
registries.why: The key_id derives from another key.

registries.name: identity_key
registries.why: The identity is a small-order point.

registries.name: order_8_key
registries.why: A point of order 8, bit 255 set.

registries.name: non_canonical_key
registries.why: y = p + 2 is a non-canonical encoding.

registries.name: retired_status
registries.why: The registry's retired key is revoked.

registries.name: no_active_key
registries.why: The receipt purpose has no active key.

registries.name: only_revoked
registries.why: A purpose present with only a revoked key has no active key.

registries.name: two_active_keys
registries.why: Two active keys for one purpose.

registries.name: off_curve_key
registries.why: No curve point has this y; the whole registry is refused beside a valid key.

registries.name: invalid_sign_key
registries.why: The identity's y with bit 255 set: x is 0, so the sign bit is invalid.

selections.name: verify_only_selected
selections.why: A verify_only key verifies what it signed before the rotation.

selections.name: unknown_refused
selections.why: The registry holds the key for no purpose.

selections.name: other_purpose_refused
selections.why: The epoch key named for a receipt.

selections.name: absent_purpose_refused
selections.why: The receipt key named for a disposition, in a registry without that purpose.

selections.name: absent_purpose_unknown
selections.why: A registry without the disposition purpose holds no key for it.

selections.name: disposition_selected
selections.why: The disposition purpose selects its own key.
